tasks.short: Procure requested food, beverages and items

steps.what: Clarify the patron's actual request for beverages, food or other items, including quantity, acceptable substitutions, destination and the existing permission and spending arrangement.

Locate the requested items at the actual venue outlet or permitted nearby supplier and ask about availability and price, resolving unavailable choices with the patron rather than substituting silently.
Formulate the exact order and check its items, quantities, supplier and total payable against the patron's clarified request and existing spending permission before placing it.
outputs: checked specific order and payment amount

steps.what: Place the checked specific order for the requested beverages, food or other items directly with the verified supplier.
inputs: checked specific order and payment amount

steps.what: Pay the checked amount using the existing authorised payment arrangement for that specific order, checking the actual charged amount and retaining the receipt or change.
inputs: checked specific order and payment amount
outputs: actual receipt and change if applicable

steps.what: Collect and check the actual purchased items against the order, ensuring correct quantities, intact packaging and the correct patron destination, and verify the actual receipt or change before handover.
inputs: actual receipt and change if applicable
outputs: checked actual items and purchase evidence for patron

steps.what: Procure the requested items for the patron by carrying and handing over the checked actual beverages, food or other items and the applicable purchase evidence, confirming the correct recipient and responding to immediate questions.
inputs: checked actual items and purchase evidence for patron
outputs: delivered requested items and purchase evidence

tasks.design: Keep the actual request, purchase and physical delivery human. Existing outlet ordering and payment arrangements already handle the transaction; no new ordering system or labour saving is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is direct service and physical item collection.
tasks.enabler_now: No new enabler is claimed; existing outlet arrangements suffice.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve an unavailable item and deliver the correct purchase to the correct patron.
tasks.human_edge: Handle preferences and practical service needs with care.

ambition.what: No expanded purchase or payment authority.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the item-procurement duties.

evidence.claim: A small requested-item purchase still needs actual request clarification, supplier interaction and physical collection and delivery.

assumptions: Boundary is this attendant's existing authorised small-purchase case, through delivery and ordinary receipt/change handover. Shares are illustrative, not measured. Supplier preparation and patron effort are not claimed or transferred; a stocked-item-only request has no payment step and yields no additional saving.

Patron supplies actual item, quantity, preferences and destination in s1. Supplier supplies actual availability and price, obtained in s2; existing venue rules supply payment authority. Attendant establishes the complete order and exact total in s3. Missing or changed information requires direct clarification counted in s1-s3, not assumed stock or permission.

Native outlet ordering/payment functions were considered but do not remove the attendant's actual service or walking work. Actual order, payment, item check and delivery are split before claiming zero. No routine written procurement report, expense claim or stock-register write is invented; any separate accounting duty earns no saving here.

s3 is the ordinary immediate final-order/amount check, not a new self-approval queue. a1 and a2 bind that exact order and amount; any change requires rechecking before action. s6 checks the actual supplied items and evidence before a3 delivery. All current work keeps full time; no change means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Stocked pickup versus paid purchase mix
research_questions: Does the real service include any repeated manual entry beyond the existing outlet transaction?

already_counted.description: Request, sourcing, final order check, ordering, payment, actual item/evidence check and delivery remain in s1-s7.

incremental.description: No proposed change introduces additional upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: Specific supplier, items and quantities checked in s3
Same specific order and exact authorised payment amount checked in s3
Actual supplied items, patron destination and purchase evidence checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual ordering, payment, receipt handling and physical delivery retain full effort; no removed manual record or transport action is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The attendant continues direct patron service and physical item procurement with the same purchase limits.
reach: Clarify unusual service requests with concierges
role.ambitious_version: Fulfil requested items carefully within the existing service and spending arrangements.
